name: cloudjobs-open-datasets
title: CloudJobs Open Datasets: Cloud Job Market Data
description: Machine-readable datasets on the cloud computing job market, aggregated from CloudJobs — a live job board tracking cloud, DevOps, SRE, and platform-engineering roles across AWS, Azure, GCP, Kubernetes, and adjacent stacks. Published as immutable monthly snapshots (tag vYYYY.MM); the live feed is at https://cloudjobs.io/datasets.

resources.name: market-overview
resources.title: Cloud Job Market Overview
resources.description: Point-in-time snapshot: total jobs, companies, median/avg salary, remote split.

resources.name: certifications
resources.title: Certification Demand & Salaries
resources.description: Job count and average salary per certification (AWS, Azure, GCP, Kubernetes, CompTIA, CISSP). Column in_catalog is false for raw free-text mentions that do not match a tracked certification.

resources.name: technologies
resources.title: Technology Demand & Salaries
resources.description: Job count and average salary per technology.

resources.name: companies
resources.title: Hiring Companies & Salaries
resources.description: Per-company role counts, remote/hybrid/onsite mix, salary min/median/max.

resources.name: locations
resources.title: Job Locations & Salaries
resources.description: Role counts and average salary by location.

resources.name: jobs
resources.title: Live Job Postings
resources.description: Full live postings feed: title, company, location, remote flag, salary range, technologies, certifications, posted date, canonical URL.
